Reject if any treated week shows the sleeve missing its entry while an in-hour evaluation existed (gate misfire), measured over 8 weekly cycles. decision_record_2a.transfer: A $500-max-loss weekly put credit spread held to settlement; the transfer is the week's single entry, whose strikes are struck off LAST week's close/ATR for a ~10:00 ET entry moment.
